Distribution (Fig. 139). Laos (new record), Myanmar (Distant 1901 a, 1902). The record from India: West Bengal: Darjiling (Arnold & Arnold 2017) requires confirmation. Nomenclature. Distant (1901 a) did not indicate the number and sex of the specimen (s) he studied, though a single measurement given suggests only one specimen. The ventral illustration of abdomen in Distant (1902) clearly shows a female. According to Maria Tavano (pers. comm.), there is only a single female labelled as ‘ typus’ in the collection of the Museum of Natural History in Genoa, most probably the only specimen Distant studied. According to the Recommendation 73 F of the ICZN (1999) we designate here the single type specimen present in MCSN (Figs 110 – 112) as lectotype to fix the identity of the species.
